items.q: Marie played piano, trombone. She played several instruments.

ctx.x: I thought that was Ma Rainey.
No, Marie Lucas had her some, because she was tall and she played -- what did Marie -- Marie played piano, trombone. She played several instruments. And she was
a musician out of this world. And very few of them ever bothered with notes, you know.
